scope: Read-only review of current documentation for shared organizational group authoring; excludes historical validation statements and historical reports.

resolvedDuringReview.description: Current shared-structure statements in both Scene2D organization paragraphs now distinguish existing actor/placement/group authoring from future fragment-definition and spatial work.
Both broad current functionality paragraphs now include shared groups and narrow unfinished structure to fragment definitions.
Current table and next-step paragraphs no longer classify shared organizational group authoring as unimplemented.
Actor membership steps now use the actual Cancel membership option label.

validatedSemantics: Add assigns one fresh group UUID to every related placement, stable across checks and language changes.
Edit changes raw display name and parent while preserving group key and existing identities; root parent is represented without declaration.
Assign changes only one shared actor groupKey or removes membership, applying to all placements without changing actor identity or geometry.
Remove only permits empty leaf groups without direct actors or direct child groups; no promotion or implicit membership rewrite, and the last group may be removed.
All organizational changes are source-owned proposals, complete candidate reviews and in-memory source application followed by ordinary Save.
Organization introduces no spatial transform, draw-order change, execution backend protocol change or cross-file/global undo authority.
128 KiB source/candidate, global declared and expanded 128-group budgets and 16-level hierarchy remain unchanged.
